# rewrite task program to choose largest connected object and return its tight bbox
p.write_text('''def transform(grid):
    pts={(r,c) for r,row in enumerate(grid) for c,v in enumerate(row) if v}
    comps=[]
    while pts:
        stack=[pts.pop()]; comp=set(stack)
        while stack:
            r,c=stack.pop()
            for q in ((r+1,c),(r-1,c),(r,c+1),(r,c-1)):
                if q in pts: pts.remove(q); comp.add(q); stack.append(q)
        comps.append(comp)
    comp=max(comps,key=len); a=min(r for r,c in comp); b=min(c for r,c in comp)
    h=max(r for r,c in comp)-a+1; w=max(c for r,c in comp)-b+1; color=grid[next(iter(comp))[0]][next(iter(comp))[1]]
    return [[color if (r+a,c+b) in comp else 0 for c in range(w)] for r in range(h)]
''')
